page.layout: One page of text in a single column; Hebrew, Chaldaic, Syriac and Greek words interspersed; a catchword-like Hebrew word at the lower right below the last line; running head at top with page number at top right.

main_text.p: לִבוּשׁ לְבוּשָׁא, לְבוּשִׁין Ch.& Syr. Vestis, vestimētum, indumen- tum: Item Gluma, folliculus grani frumentarii, 2. Reg.4.42. Plur. לִבוּשִׁין, לְבוּשַׁיָּא, Syr. ܠܒܘܫܐ. Affi- ne est Græc. λαῦφ@. הלבִּשוּשׁ Vide in lit. ה.
לגב לגלג Ch. Irridere, subsannare, Genef.34.31. in Jon. Ithpah. אִתְלַגְלַג Irrideri, contemni, sperni, Esth. 1.17. Videtur ortum esse ex לעג elifo ע, quod in hac lingua frequens, vel commutato in ג.
לגה לגיון, לגיוֹ Ch. & Syr. Legio. Plural. לגיונין, Syr. ܠܓܝܘܢܐ Legiones Ange- lorum, Matth.26.53.
לגן לגינתא, לגינא, לגין Chald. Lagena, Hydria, Utris, Græc. λάγυνος, Genef.24.14.15.16.17.18.20. in Tar- gum Jonath. Plural. לגינין דהסף Lagenæ testaceæ, Thren.4.3.
לגת לגן Syr. Catinus, patina, paropsis, Matth. 26.23. & Mar.14.20. Græc. τηγάνιον.
לדן לדנא Ch. Vagina. Plur. לדנין Idem quod נרן, facta commutatione ל & נ.
להא להה, לאה. Chal. Laborare, Defatigare, Idem quod לאה. Aphel אַלְהִי Defatigare: Defatigare se.
להי להיי Ch. Defessus, defatigatus. Plur. foem. להיין Deuter. 25.18. in Targ.Hierof.
להב לַהֲבֵי, לְהַבָּא Ch. Flamma, בְּלַהֲבֵי אֶשְׁתָּא In flamma ignis, Exod.3.3. in T. Jon.
להוב לַהֲבוּתָא, לְהוּב Ch. Idem, Nah.3.3. Psal.106.18.

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldaic, Syriac and Greek words are reproduced as far as legible; several Syriac and Hebrew forms with vowel points are approximate. The word at the lower right (להב) is treated as a catchword.
